triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: topology_critic_receipt_set refuses a session sourced from LATTICE_SESSION_ID with an error naming the received source, while a genuinely dispatched critic whose session the host derived still signs request_changes successfully.
acceptanceBindings.note: The claim has two halves and both must hold. The refusal half is covered by CHK-001 adversarial and CHK-003 adversarial (mutation-proven). The still-signs half is covered by CHK-004 happy, which is the item guarding decision_set preMortem 1: a guard that blocks every critic would satisfy the refusal half alone while making the original deadlock worse. CHK-004 adversarial additionally pins the 9f9f53a514 asymmetry so pass cannot become reachable on a stale basis while attention is on session identity.
